description: Get the dilution pressure score: 0-100 with a seven-component breakdown (shelf capacity, ATM/equity-line capacity, warrants in the money, convertible proximity, cash burn urgency, historical dilution, toxic financing), plus four risk levels: overall, offering ability, overhead supply, cash need. 🔴 SCORE: components whose inputs could not be measured are DROPPED FROM THE DENOMINATOR, so 58 may be 58 out of 85. Always report `score`/`scoreMaxMeasured` and name the excluded `scoreUnmeasuredComponents`; NEVER rescale it to /100, and never read a low numerator as low risk. `scoreDenominatorThin: true` (under 70 measured points) is a PARTIAL reading ("N of M measured"). A non-null `scoreWithheldReason` (e.g. `no_dilution_snapshot`) means NO score, not zero. With no filed share count, share-count / market-cap components rest on `details.sharesOutstandingEstimate` {shares, kind, asOf, source} (`details.marketCapSource: "derived_price_x_estimated_os"`): say they rest on an estimate. 🔴 LEVELS: when `levelsAreLowerBound` (always present) is true, the levels named in `levelsLowerBoundScope` are floors, not measurements: "medium" means AT LEAST medium. State those (and only those) as a lower bound. `levelsLowerBoundReason`: `unquantified_live_instruments` floors overall + overheadSupply; `offering_capacity_unknown` and `market_cap_unmeasured` floor overall + offeringAbility, NOT `overheadSupply`; `os_growth_span_short`, `os_growth_issuance_floor`, `os_growth_rebased_partial` floor historical + overall; `overhead_capacity_unquantified` floors overheadSupply + overall. Name the stated reason, never another. `details.levelBounds` per level: `floor` (unsized instruments at zero), `ceiling` (at filed maximum; null = some instrument has none), `exact`, `bestEstimate`, `estimated`, `estimateBasis`; report an estimated level as a best estimate with its floor and ceiling, never as a measurement. A null `overall` with a non-null `levelsWithheldReason` is WITHHELD, not low. `offeringAbility` is a capability profile, not pressure today: a live ATM/equity line with a MEASURED $0 drawable (e.g. clamped by the I.B.6 cap) reads medium while the score prices the $0; do not say the company cannot raise. `atmRemainingBasis` / `elocRemainingBasis` `total_minus_reported_sales` / `total_no_sales_reported` are "up to" figures. `overheadSupply` = potential dilution EXCLUDING shelf as a % of shares outstanding: warrants, convertibles, preferred at GROSS counts, plus live ATM remaining (baby-shelf clamped) and equity-line remaining at the current price, plus live S-1 shares, plus `details.registeredResaleOverhangShares`. Low up to 20%, Medium 20-50%, High over 50%. `details.overheadSupplyBasis` itemises the components (null = NOT MEASURED) and `unquantified`; it is NOT the treasury-netted `inTheMoneySupplyPct` / `totalDilutiveShares`. When `details.osGrowthRate` is null, `details.osGrowthFacts` {fromShares, fromDate, toShares, toDate, splitsInWindow, basis} is a FACT, never a rating; with `basis: "as_filed"` the counts must not be compared as growth. ALWAYS RETURNS 200: read `available` and `reason`, never the HTTP status. `not_covered` means this company has not been analysed yet, not that it has no dilution; an outage is a 5xx. NULL, absent or withheld means NOT MEASURED; it never means "no dilution", "no warrants", "no shelf" or zero. A numeric 0 is a MEASURED zero and defeats a null check: decide from the availability/withheld/reason field, never from the value itself. Figures are as of `meta.asOfDate`, from filings read through `meta.filingsThrough` (a stale date predates anything filed since). Share counts are on one split basis; a row that cannot be rebased is omitted and counted, never published on a mixed basis. Included in Signal8 Pro: without it the call returns 403 FEATURE_NOT_AVAILABLE with `requiredTier: "pro"` (a tier upgrade; there is no add-on to buy).

title: Get Dilution Pressure Score and Risk Levels
